name: plush
kind: 3D model with an automatic 4-bone spine rig
notes: the spine bends the whole body; hair and other parts follow the spine bone at their height. Arm bones (arm_L, arm_R) point sideways: lean raises (+) or lowers (-) the arm, sway swings it forward/back, twist rolls it around its own length.

description.body_plan: A pear-shaped plush character has a continuous tan body, blue arms, a face on its upper front, and long curly hair covering its back.

bone_regions.root: base of the body and overall position
bone_regions.upper: upper body, face, and mid-length hair

substitutions.arms: Use the blue arms to gesture, swing, and reach.
substitutions.legs: Suggest steps with small hops, side-to-side shifts, and body bounces.
substitutions.hips: Use lower-body sway and twist to suggest hip movement.
substitutions.head: Use gentle upper-spine and top-bone turns to orient the face.
substitutions.torso: Bend and twist the spine to make the whole plush body groove.

constraints: Keep the body from sinking into the floor.
Do not imply separate knees, feet, or a detached head.
Avoid bends that severely distort the face or pull the hair away from the body.
Keep arm rotations within the rig limits.
